description: Query OSV.dev for package vulnerabilities and batch-audit dependency lists via MCP.
name: io.github.cyanheads/osv-advisory-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for OSV.dev API calls.
environmentVariables.name: OSV_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of concurrent OSV.dev requests issued by osv_query_batch.
environmentVariables.name: OSV_BATCH_CONCURRENCY

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of OSV.dev result pages osv_query_package follows before marking a result truncated.
environmentVariables.name: OSV_QUERY_MAX_PAGES

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: HTTP session mode. This server deploys stateless because its tools do not use multi-round input.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SESSION_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
